correctness.rationale: The base f(x)=|x|-1 enters [-1,0] in finite time and satisfies f²=id there. The forced two-step modulus map has an explicitly verified reflection interval after finitely many bounded translations. This proves global finite entrance, invariance and T⁴=id. The periodic-set equality follows by forward invariance plus periodicity, and its area is the exact section-length integral 1/2. The subcritical return is a c²-contraction; a bounded fixed-point limit produces the discontinuous selected graph. The rational checker verifies algebra and sample branches but is not an infinite proof.
